entries.subject: DAMIT 167: selected shape and spin
entries.finding: DAMIT model 167, version 2011-03-28, pole (30°, -64°), period 14.20569 h, taken unchanged from the archive.

entries.subject: Physical scale
entries.finding: 38 ± 5 km, occultation-constrained volume-equivalent diameter. DAMIT marks model 167 as size-calibrated (D = 38 km, σ = 5 km) and archives the 2005-12-13 occultation fit to this mesh. DAMIT labels the model 'preliminary'. NEOWISE lists 39.025 ± 0.462 km (Masiero et al. 2014), consistent within the quoted error.
